87aac61ce4.q: What happened to Mark Raymond Jr on July 4 2016 at Lake Pontchartrain?
87aac61ce4.a: Mark Raymond Jr dove off the back of a boat into shallow water at Lake Pontchartrain while celebrating his friend's four-year contract with the Knicks. He hit his forehead on the sandy bottom in approximately 1.5 feet of water and became paralyzed, unable to move. His best friends performed CPR, he lost his pulse multiple times during the boat ride to the marina and ambulance transport, and he was placed in an induced coma at the hospital due to pneumonia that developed from drowning.

36f9e0917f.q: What is a C5 spinal cord injury and what was Mark Raymond Jr's recovery timeline?
36f9e0917f.a: Mark Raymond Jr sustained a spinal cord injury at the C5 level, which initially left him unable to lift his arms and required him to lay flat on his back with a neck collar and breathing tube. It took him literally about a year to get comfortable sitting up and to develop shoulder mobility, arm mobility, and arm strength. He spent six weeks in University Medical Center ICU, six weeks at Turo inpatient therapy, and was discharged to home on September 21st.

c37cd81c38.q: How did Mark Raymond Jr overcome depression and suicidal ideation after his spinal cord injury?
c37cd81c38.a: After the first year of grief, guilt, and depression during which Mark Raymond Jr was living in the past and experiencing suicidal ideation, he and his mother decided to get out of their routine. They found a program called SCI Fit in Sacramento, California on Instagram that was pushing the traditional norms of recovery after spinal cord injury. They booked a one-way ticket and stayed with friends, and on day one at the facility, everyone in the room greeted him, making him feel welcomed and beginning his path toward acceptance.

589cfdb8e5.q: What does Split Second Foundation do for spinal cord injury survivors?
589cfdb8e5.a: While the specific programs and services of Split Second Foundation are not detailed in this episode, Mark Raymond Jr founded it as a result of his own recovery journey from a C5 spinal cord injury. He has become an entrepreneur and overcomer dedicated to making life better for others facing similar traumatic injuries, drawing from his personal experience of transformation from paralysis through recovery and purpose.

edb85965bc.q: What is spinal shock and how does it affect consciousness and recovery?
edb85965bc.a: Spinal shock is a condition Mark Raymond Jr experienced after his spinal cord injury where he was somewhat conscious at the hospital but has no memory of it. He was placed in an induced coma using propofol so his body would not fight too hard and could stabilize. He remained unconscious for two and a half weeks, waking around July 22nd or 23rd with no reference of time and unable to speak due to the tracheostomy tube.
